system.description: Battle Rage. At the start of the encounter, place a token on space 0. When a Dark Elf inflicts one or more critical wounds, advance the token one space. When the token reaches stress and 1 fatigue, the Dark Elf suffers 1 stress and 1 fatigue, and one of their normal wounds becomes a critical wound. Reset the Fueled by Hatred track to space 0. = ks = HATRED FUELED
